record.body:
## Evidence

expected: R1 — every advertised skill directory contains every file its instructions reference; no referenced path leaves the directory.
observed: `skills/execute-phase/SKILL.md:422` tells the parent to dispatch `agents/se-reviewer.md`, which lives at the host/plugin root (the installer generates it under `<host>/agents/`), not inside `skills/execute-phase/`. A skills-only install through the `npx skills add` tail ships no `agents/` tree, so the instruction dangles. `tests/test_skill_portability.py` only checks markdown links and backticked paths beginning `./`, `../`, or `references/`, so the bare `agents/se-reviewer.md` is never examined.

## Consequence

Phase merge is blocked until the finding is fixed or cleared.

## Follow-up

Create a fix work-item under the retry budget, or answer Needs you.

payload.basis: Reviewer observed skills/execute-phase/SKILL.md:422 dispatching agents/se-reviewer.md, while the installer generates that file under <host>/agents/ and the npx skills add tail ships no agents/ tree; tests/test_skill_portability.py only examines ./ ../ and references/ paths
payload.claim: spec-gap on portable-skill-refs: skills/execute-phase/SKILL.md names agents/se-reviewer.md outside the skill directory, so R1's every-referenced-file-inside rule is unmet and a skills-only install has a dangling instruction
payload.invalidated_when: fix lands and reviewer re-run passes, or human clears
